function: Learns the base-station digital and holographic (amplitude-only) beamformers that maximize downlink multiuser sum spectral efficiency (p. 1-2).
system: Downlink HMIMO: BS with 12x12 holographic surface (Nt=144 leaky-wave elements), NRF=4 RF chains, K=4 single-antenna users; no RIS; 30 GHz (p. 2, 5).
method: Gradient-based graph neural network (GGNN) plus two closed-form projection modules; unsupervised training with negative sum-SE loss, Adam optimizer (p. 3-5).
data_channel: Synthetic two-path (LoS+NLoS) multipath channel from [8], uniform AoDs, 500,000 training and 10,000 test samples; also 3GPP CDL-D channel in Fig. 3(d) (p. 5).
test_conditions: Default SNR 20 dB, K=4, NRF=4, Nx=12; generalization: trained K=6, NRF=10, tested K=4-8; trained with random phase patterns (mean Nx=10), tested Nx=10-14 (p. 5-6).
baselines: Non-learned: AO [8], fully digital WMMSE upper bound. Learned: DecGNN [13], MDGNN [12], TNN [15]; VAGNN is an ablation of the proposed model (p. 5).
metrics: Spectral efficiency (sum SE), SE ratio to AO, inference latency, FLOPs order, training samples, time and space (p. 4-6).
complexity: FLOPs formula and Big-O order O(LCKNt(K+C)+NtNRF K) vs AO O(K^2+Nt^3) (p. 4); inference latency 20.36 ms vs AO 59.23 s, training 3.86 h (p. 6).
q1_support: p. 5: "we also evaluate the schemes under the 3GPP Clustered Delay Line (CDL)-D channel model"
q2_support: p. 5: "all methods are trained with NRF = 10 and K = 6, and tested with K ranging from 4 to 8"
q3_support: p. 5: "the proposed method consistently outperforms the baseline schemes. Specifically, it improves the SE by 5.1%–22.8% over MDGNN"; p. 5: "AO: The AO algorithm in [8]"
q4_support: p. 4: "TABLE I: Inference Complexity in Order of Magnitude of FLOPs"; p. 6: "TABLE II: Comparison of Inference and Training Complexity"
q5_support: p. 5: "The channel model includes two multipath components per user"; samples are generated by the authors, and the paper gives no code or data link or DOI and uses no public or measured dataset.
notes: ris=0: the holographic surface is the BS's own leaky-wave antenna fed by RF chains (p. 2), not a RIS, and the paper never uses the term RIS. q1=1 rests only on the CDL-D evaluation of Fig. 3(d) (p. 5); the main results use a custom two-path model from [8] (p. 5), and the paper does not say whether the networks were trained on CDL-D samples, so the reviewer should confirm. q3: VAGNN is an ablation (p. 5) and is not counted; the counted learned baselines are DecGNN, MDGNN, and TNN, and AO is the non-learned one. q2: generalization over the number of users (Fig. 4) and of antennas (Fig. 5, p. 5-6).
